wls_caveat: URTH (MSCI World: developed, large/mid) is a PROXY for Bloomberg WLS (World Large/Mid/Small incl. EM). Tracking error is UNMEASURED; the challenge portal's number is the truth, this is not.
read_me_first: Every book is NET of an empirical entry cost by liquidity band and measured against its benchmark over the same window, and against its own twins. A book that returns +8% while SPY returns +11% has LOST.
